eventKinds.hash_announcement: original P2P hash arrival, eligible only after checked resolution and live filtering
eventKinds.full_broadcast: unsolicited full payload, eligible only after local signature/hash checks and live filtering
eventKinds.requested_response: matched response to this observer's explicit request; excluded from unsolicited counts
eventKinds.historical_or_unresolved: unmatched response; excluded from unsolicited counts

timestamps.arrivedAt: observer UTC when the complete authenticated encrypted frame was available
timestamps.monotonicNs: elapsed since this process boot; compare only within the same boot
timestamps.slotTimestamp: momentum slot time, not the producer's transmission time

verification.rpc_agreed: Two configured endpoints report the same checked hash and producer at that height; operator independence and consensus finality are not established.
verification.disputed: Reference sources disagree, a competing branch was observed, or checked signer claims conflict.
verification.signerConflict: Producer remains null when the same hash has conflicting checked signer claims.
